summary: Dimension (single match-strategy field spec) and DimensionsMetadata (collection with YAML round-trip and table-level hit-policy fields) Pydantic models. Validates strategy/data-type/field combinations at construction.
extension_points: New MatchStrategy validation logic added in model_validator '_validate_strategy_fields'.
lifecycle_notes: Dimension construction validates strategy/type combinations, range fields, literal context regex patterns and unsupported boolean set dimensions.
Raw Python data_type classes are converted with a DeprecationWarning; serializable DataType values are preferred.
DimensionsMetadata rejects duplicate dimension names and requires priority_field for PRIORITY; actual rule-column/policy schema checks are performed by evaluation code.
YAML serialization uses safe_dump with defaults omitted; from_yaml uses safe_load then Pydantic model validation.
valid_values is declarative metadata, not an engine-side domain restriction.
documentation_hooks: Separate metadata construction validation from runtime rule-schema and context validation.
Explain resolved_context_field/resolved_rule_field fallback and range inclusivity controls.
risks: A valid DimensionsMetadata object does not prove the provided rule table contains required policy columns.
valid_values must not be documented as an enforced engine filter.

evidence.detail: TestYamlRoundTrip, TestDataTypeMigration and TestValidValues cover metadata contracts; inspected, not executed in this profile run.
Quick Start, Match Strategies and Serialisable Metadata provide concrete examples for a non-specialist capability overview; no performance or deployment guarantees inferred.
